About the Scholarship

Griffith's second postgraduate research scholarship round supports the April and July 2027 intakes. Applications open in November 2026. International eligibility in this round is restricted, so candidates must check the Griffith Pathway conditions before relying on this deadline.

Research Areas

  • Eligible Griffith research subjects
  • Doctoral study
  • Research training

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryLiving stipend; exact amount not verified on checked round page

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityDomestic applicants and eligible Griffith Pathway international applicants
Further conditionsInternational eligibility in this round is restricted to Griffith Pathway applicants; check live rules.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusUpcoming: opens 2 November 2026
Deadline / consideration round5 February 2027
LocationAustralia

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.griffith.edu.au/research-study

Source: griffith.edu.au - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 5 February 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

  1. Review the official programme page and check the opening date for the next call.
  2. Use the new call to select a project or research area and identify the documents required for that application route.
  3. Complete the submission when the application window opens, using the new deadline rather than an earlier recruitment cycle.

About Griffith University

Griffith offers research degrees through its academic schools and graduate research community. Its postgraduate research scholarships support living costs, with tuition support and eligibility assessed under the relevant award and round.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions
